expected_units.meaning: The adjudicator/official must require the applicant to submit a new photograph whenever the submitted photograph fails to meet the specified photo requirements.

source_spans.quote: You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:

expected_units.meaning: The submitted passport photograph is required to be in color; non-color photographs fail requirements and necessitate a request for a new photograph.

source_spans.quote: The photograph must be in color
You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:

expected_units.meaning: The photograph should be taken within six months prior to application submission and must serve as a good likeness that satisfactorily identifies the applicant as of the application date.

source_spans.quote: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application (see 22 CFR 51.26).
You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:

expected_units.meaning: A photograph displaying a different hairstyle or facial hair compared to the submitted identification document is acceptable provided it remains a good likeness of the applicant.

source_spans.quote: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted is acceptable if it still is a good likeness of the applicant
You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:

expected_units.meaning: Even when a Certificate of Citizenship or Naturalization was issued recently, USCIS processing times mean that the photograph appearing on it may not satisfy the requirement of being taken within six months of passport application submission.

source_spans.quote: even if the certificate itself was recently issued, because of U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services processing times, the photograph may not have been taken within six months of submitting the application.
NOTE: Applicants may wish to re-use a passport photograph that is depicted on their submitted U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization.

expected_units.meaning: The submitted photograph must have no material damage; if it has material damage, a new photograph must be requested.

source_spans.quote: The photograph must be free of material damage:

expected_units.meaning: Material damage is defined as any damage occurring in the facial area that destroys the photograph's status as a good likeness of the applicant (including creases, large holes, or large smudges) or obstructs facial recognition systems (such as damage around the eye region).

source_spans.quote: Material damage is any damage to the facial area that makes the photograph no longer a good likeness of the applicant (e.g., creases, large holes, and large smudges) or impedes the functioning of facial recognition (damage in the area of the eyes)
The photograph must be free of material damage:

expected_units.meaning: Immaterial damage is defined as any damage restricted to the background of the photo, as well as non-material damage affecting the facial area (such as staple holes).

source_spans.quote: Immaterial damage is any damage to the background, and non-material damage to the facial area (e.g., staple holes).
The photograph must be free of material damage:

expected_units.meaning: A photograph possessing only immaterial damage is permissible and acceptable.

source_spans.quote: Immaterial damage is acceptable

expected_units.meaning: Applicants are not required to sign their photograph, in order to avoid the risk of creating creases or smudges.

source_spans.quote: The applicant does not need to sign the photograph, as this often causes creases or smudges
The photograph must be free of material damage:

expected_units.meaning: When handling hand-carry passport applications, the acceptance agent is required to sign the back of the photograph.

source_spans.quote: For hand-carry applications, the acceptance agent signs the back of the photograph.

expected_units.meaning: If a photograph that looked undamaged in the system reveals a defect upon passport printing, the application may be sent back to adjudication to require a replacement photograph.

source_spans.quote: Consequently, the passport application may be returned to adjudication to request a new photograph even though the photograph appeared acceptable.
(d) A photograph that appears acceptable and undamaged in the system may have a defect that is apparent when the passport is printed.

expected_units.meaning: Eyeglasses are strictly unacceptable in photographs, except when they cannot be taken off for documented medical justifications (such as following recent ocular surgery where glasses are essential to safeguard the eyes).

source_spans.quote: Eyeglasses are not acceptable unless they cannot be removed for medical reasons, e.g., the applicant has recently had ocular surgery and the eyeglasses are necessary to protect the applicant’s eyes.
e. Eyeglasses/contact lenses:

expected_units.meaning: When an applicant cannot remove eyeglasses for medical reasons, adjudicators must require a medical statement signed by a medical professional or health practitioner.

source_spans.quote: A medical statement signed by a medical professional/health practitioner must be requested in these rare circumstances.
e. Eyeglasses/contact lenses:

(1) Eyeglasses are not acceptable unless they cannot be removed for medical reasons, e.g., the applicant has recently had ocular surgery and the eyeglasses are necessary to protect the applicant’s eyes.

expected_units.meaning: When eyeglasses are permitted for medical reasons, the eyeglass frames are prohibited from covering any part of the applicant's eye or eyes.

source_spans.quote: The frames of the eyeglasses must not cover the eye(s)
e. Eyeglasses/contact lenses:
If the eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons:

expected_units.meaning: When eyeglasses are accepted on medical grounds, there must not be any glare reflecting off the eyeglasses that obstructs or obscures the eye or eyes.

source_spans.quote: There must not be glare on eyeglasses that obscures the eye(s)
e. Eyeglasses/contact lenses:
If the eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons:

expected_units.meaning: When eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons, neither shadows nor optical refraction from the glasses may obscure the applicant's eye or eyes.

source_spans.quote: There must not be shadows or refraction from the eyeglasses that obscure the eye(s)
e. Eyeglasses/contact lenses:
If the eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons:

expected_units.meaning: Dark or tinted lenses in eyeglasses are allowed only on the condition that the signed medical statement explicitly specifies that they are medically required.

source_spans.quote: Dark or tinted lenses are permitted if the medical statement also indicates that they are required.
e. Eyeglasses/contact lenses:
If the eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons:

expected_units.meaning: If the medical circumstance necessitating eyeglasses is temporary and the applicant has urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport utilizing endorsement 46 should be issued.

source_spans.quote: A limited-validity passport using endorsement 46 should be issued when the medical circumstance that requires eyeglasses is temporary and the applicant has urgent or emergency travel.
